messages:
maria vu: Hi folks, first day! Trying to get my dev box ready (M1 MBP). Hitting a cascade of path/asdf/brew problems, wondering if theres a canonical checklist.
jordan: Welcome Maria :wave: We have a checklist in the onboarding doc but lots of tacit tips. Whats failing exactly?
maria vu: asdf installs fail for openssl deps when building ruby and some npm native modules. brew is at /opt/homebrew but my shell still shows /usr/local/bin first.
sophie park: For zsh the usual is to put `eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"` at the top of ~/.zprofile so brew sets PATH before login shell stuff. If you use bash, put it in ~/.bash_profile.
maria vu: I use zsh. After adding that brew shellenv, terminal still had the wrong PATH until I restarted it. Now asdf picks up /opt/homebrew.
infra-bot: PSA: If you need x86-only binaries, run: `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license`. Some build tools still require Rosetta.
maria vu: Rosetta installed. Next: openssl libs not found by ruby build.
sophie park: Try `brew install openssl@1.1 pkg-config` and export before asdf install: `export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib"` `export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include"` `export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib/pkgconfig"`. Then `asdf install ruby <version>`.
jordan: If youre installing node via asdf-nodejs, also run the release team keyring import: `bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring` (necessary for the plugin to verify distros).
maria vu: That fixed ruby. Node plugin still defaulting to system node though. My PATH shows /opt/homebrew/bin after /usr/bin. How do we ensure ~/.asdf/shims is before brew?
sophie park: Put `export PATH="$HOME/.asdf/shims:$HOME/.asdf/bin:$PATH"` in your shell rc (eg ~/.zshrc) after brew shellenv. For login shells zprofile runs first so keep shellenv in zprofile and shim in zshrc.
maria vu: Good call. One last setup q: SSH keys and dotfiles. Where do I add my pubkey and how do I get our dotfiles? The welcome email link seems missing.
jordan: Add your public key as a file to the infra repo under `infrastructure/ssh-keys/` and open a PR, or ping @dev-support for a quick add. Dotfiles are in a private repo; you should have an invite. If not DM @dev-support.
dev-support: Sent the dotfiles repo invite to your work email and added your key. Also we use ~/.local/bin for project helpers; add `export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"` after asdf shims.
maria vu: Thanks! I also had to `brew unlink node && asdf reshim nodejs` to remove the brew-installed node conflict. That may help others.
sophie park: Nice note, please paste that into the onboarding doc under "mac setup" so future hires see it.
infra-bot: deploy-helpers: Reminder: dont commit private keys. Use `ssh-add -K ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` for mac keychain (or `ssh-add --apple-use-keychain` on newer macOS).
maria vu: Everything's green now (ruby, node, yarn, docker desktop). Appreciate the quick help :pray:
jordan: Welcome aboard :tada: If anything else pops up ping #devex or @dev-support.
